job.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer - Sponsored Content & Products (all genders)
job.email_subject: Application: Senior Full Stack Engineer – Sponsored Content & Products
job.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Sponsored products need product data, promotion logic and storefront working together at scale – that is my daily work on large e-commerce platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell.

– OCC REST / headless APIs for storefronts, PWA and third parties
– 5+ years SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) at Rockwell Automation and Shell
– Led query refactoring that cut response latency
– Daily use of generative AI / LLM tools in analysis, coding and docs

I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026. I am also an SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer and Business User. My CV and cover letter are attached. Do you have time for a short call in the coming days? I look forward to hearing from you.

Kind regards
Kranti Chavan

tailoring.headline: Senior Full Stack Engineer E-Commerce | Java APIs, Storefronts & Product Data
tailoring.summary: Full stack e-commerce engineer with 5+ years building and extending large commerce platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Backend strength in Java, Spring Boot and RESTful APIs, plus headless commerce and PWA frontend integrations and storefront customization with JavaScript. Experienced with product catalogs, promotions engines and order management, PIM data pipelines and SQL performance tuning. Executes CI/CD deployment cycles, performs code reviews and uses AI tools daily in development and testing.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

tailoring.why_company: ABOUT YOU is one of Europe's most tech-driven fashion platforms, and sponsored content sits right where commerce, data and storefront meet. I want to bring five years of headless APIs, promotions and catalog engineering into a product team that ships features for millions of shoppers. From Karlsruhe, with a valid work permit, I can start on 16 December 2026.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi! Your Senior Full Stack Engineer (Sponsored Content & Products) role fits well: 5+ years e-commerce engineering – Java APIs, headless/PWA, promotions, catalogs – for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Start 16.12.2026. Open to a short call?

en.subject: Application: Senior Full Stack Engineer – Sponsored Content & Products
en.hook: Sponsored products only work when product data, promotion logic and the storefront play together at scale. That combination has been my daily work for more than five years: at Rockwell Automation and Shell I build headless APIs, promotions, catalogs and storefront features on large e-commerce platforms.

bullets.label: Full stack product features
bullets.text: Built APIs for headless commerce and PWA frontends and customized storefronts and Backoffice components with JavaScript and responsive design.

bullets.label: APIs for many consumers
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST web services (headless APIs) for storefronts, PWA frontends and third-party consumers; customized Interceptors, Populators and Converters for custom data flows.

bullets.label: Product & promotion logic
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) with Java and Spring for product, catalog, pricing and customer data; developed and maintained Promotions Engine, Order Management (OMS), Cronjobs, Impex and FlexibleSearch.

bullets.label: Performance at scale
bullets.text: Led database query refactoring that reduced response latency and improved transaction speed; engineered API migrations for customer account structures that improved stability and data consistency.

en.logistics: I work well in international product teams and enjoy turning commercial ideas into shipped features. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. I would be glad to show you in a conversation how I can strengthen ABOUT YOU.
